title: KTA — Template Editor
subtitle: Configure member-card layout: photo, identity, QR.
cetakSubtitle: Select members and a template, then print single or batch.

side.label: Side
side.frontHint: Edit fields on the front of the card.
side.backHint: The back side prints as page 2 (or a separate page in the PDF). Defaults to a Library Code of Conduct.

gallery.title: KTA Template Gallery
gallery.description: Pick one of the bundled designs as a starting point. You can still tweak colours, positions, and text through the template editor afterwards.
gallery.appliedHint: Click 'Save' to persist, or tweak colours / positions first.

foto.toolsHelp: New photos are automatically cropped to portrait 3:4 on upload. Use the button to rewrite legacy photos (uploaded before this feature) so they match the KTA slot.
foto.refitConfirm: Re-fit every member photo to portrait 3:4? Original files will be overwritten in place (no undo). Photos already at 3:4 are skipped.
foto.refitSummary: {{refit}} photos re-fit, {{skipped}} skipped, {{failed}} failed (out of {{total}} total).
